policyname: Doctors can delete own draft verification files
qual:
((bucket_id = 'doctor-verification-documents'::text) AND (owner_id = (auth.uid())::text) AND ((storage.foldername(name))[1] = (auth.uid())::text) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM (doctor_verification_submissions submission
     JOIN doctors doctor ON ((doctor.id = submission.doctor_id)))
  WHERE (((submission.id)::text = (storage.foldername(objects.name))[2]) AND (submission.status = 'draft'::text) AND (doctor.profile_id = auth.uid())))))
